messages:
caitlin: customer reports 400 from /v1/tools/invoke — JSON schema validation error. payload rejected for additionalProperties 'billing_profile' and missing required 'customer_id'. error payload: {
  "keyword": "additionalProperties",
  "params": {"additionalProperty": "billing_profile"},
  "message": "must NOT have additional properties"
}

harish: can you paste the exact request body + client/sdk version? Also is this Hosted/Dedicated/private?

caitlin: Hosted. SDK: redwood-js v0.7.2. Payload (redacted):

```json
{
  "tool": "payments-processor",
  "input": {
    "amount": 12500,
    "currency": "USD"
  },
  "meta": {
    "customer": {
      "name": "ACME Health"
    }
  },
  "billing_profile": [
    { "plan": "enterprise", "tier": 3 }
  ]
}
```

caitlin: note: customer_id is not present anywhere — they relied on billing_profile[0].id previously.

support-bot: created ticket RED-INC-431 and attached initial logs.

lia: looks like schema for the tool function expects a billing object with required customer_id (string) and billing.profile as OBJECT, not array. sending billing_profile array triggers additionalProperties because field not allowed in current schema. also missing required customer_id triggers separate validation error.

harish: trying to repro locally with same payload + token. saw gateway log: 

```
2026-03-16T18:22:01Z WARN validation:toolrouter request_id=rp_9a1b validate failed keyword=additionalProperties prop=billing_profile path=/ body_len=842
2026-03-16T18:22:01Z INFO rpc:auth token_scope=tools.invoke tenant=acme-health user_id=usr_321
```

oncall-sre: FYI we had a latency spike 18:20-18:25 that coincides with a surge of older SDK clients. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for cascading failures.

janet: I pushed a schema bump to prod (v3.2.0) yesterday that tightened the tool function schema (billing.profile must be OBJECT and customer_id required). older SDKs (<=0.7.2) were allowed previously and some customers used an array shim. we should either: (1) add a compatibility shim at the gateway to coerce billing_profile array -> object (best short-term), or (2) ask customers to upgrade SDK and return clear validation message pointing to migration doc.

harish: created repro script and curl for ENG to run:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool":"payments-processor","input":{"amount":12500,"currency":"USD"},"billing_profile":[{"plan":"enterprise","tier":3}]}'
```

caitlin: customer applied manual patch to send correct object and top-level customer_id and it succeeded. they can keep on hosted but will upgrade SDK. pushing repro + suggested gateway shim to RED-INC-431.

lia: recommend adding clear 400 body with: {"error":"schema_validation_failed", "details": ["missing required property: billing.customer_id", "unexpected property: billing_profile"]} so customers get actionable guidance.

janet: agree. I'll open PR for shim and clearer error text. tagging @devex to update migration notes.

caitlin: thanks all — will follow up with customer and mark resolved after SDK patch release. :white_check_mark:
